## How to query (for CCO / regulators)

```bash
# All P0/P1 incidents in May 2026:
grep -l 'date: 2026-05' docs/incidents/*.md \
  | xargs grep -lE '^severity:\s*(P0|P1)'

# All client-facing incidents ever:
grep -l '^category: client' docs/incidents/*.md

# All currently-open incidents:
grep -l '^status: open' docs/incidents/*.md
```
